name: happy-feet-travellers
description: Happy Feet Travellers — monorepo: Next.js frontend + Express/Prisma backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n FE,ADMIN,BE -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n FE,ADMIN,BE -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start -w frontend" "npm run start -w admin" "npm run start -w backend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w admin
